name: Tim Harrison
title: Strategic communications consultant and executive coach
bio_short: Strategic communications consultant with more than 20 years' experience. Former HSBC Regional Head of Communications for MENA. Oxford graduate. Specialist in media, crisis, investor relations and stakeholder communication for senior executives.
bio: Tim is a strategic communications consultant with more than 20 years' experience helping organisations deliver their messages effectively to media, investors, regulators, policymakers and employees. He operates at the most senior levels, devising and executing strategic communications plans that encompass media relations, crisis and issues management, reputation management, investor relations and internal communications.  Tim spent 10 years at HSBC, first as Regional Head of Communications for the Middle East and North Africa, then in global communications roles. Before HSBC, he worked across a range of sectors both as a consultant and in-house, with experience at Abbey National/Santander, BNY Mellon, Edelman, Asda'a PR and Charles Barker. He is an Oxford University graduate.  At ISOC, Tim delivers strategic communications, media training, crisis communication and investor relations programmes for senior executives and leadership teams. His combination of in-house and consultancy experience, particularly his decade at one of the world's largest banks, gives him a practical understanding of communications at the intersection of business strategy, regulation and reputation. He is particularly effective with financial services clients and organisations that need to communicate with sophisticated, sceptical stakeholder audiences. Tim is based in the UK and trains in English.
